source_hash_method: Sorted src/**/*.rs, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, build.rs; each relative path, NUL, bytes, NUL
notes: Release build without profiler or PGO. No concurrent builds/tests/profiling during timed measurements. Host services active; frequency not fixed.
Micro: seven fresh-process measurements after two warmups per loop/workload; asyncio,uvloop,zuvloop,rsloop.

Network: seven measured runs after two warmups in one process per loop/scenario; rsloop,uvloop,zuvloop; 16 connections, 500 operations/connection for request/response workloads; bulk transfers 2 MiB/connection in 64 KiB chunks.
Idle: nine rotating paired process blocks; 100 cycles plus five warmups, 200 established connections, 0.2 seconds idle/cycle.
Compact run-level data retains latency quantiles and idle milestone medians; individual request/cycle samples omitted. Not direct input to check_regression.py.
